# Codex Discord Rich Presence

> Local Rust runtime and terminal dashboard for OpenAI Codex, publishing configurable Discord Rich Presence for Codex CLI, the VS Code extension, Codex App, ChatGPT App and supported OpenCode-hosted GPT sessions.

- Runtime version 1.15.0 (unreleased; 1.11.3 published); codex-presence-core version 2.0.1; configuration schema 13.
- Reads local Codex JSONL sessions and metadata, plus supported GPT sessions in OpenCode's local store.
- Only Codex/OpenAI identities and assets publish. No transcript uploads, analytics telemetry or cloud storage.
- Unknown prices, limits and context values are unavailable, never zero. Costs preserve coverage and provenance.
- Windows x64/ARM64, Linux x64 and macOS Intel/Apple Silicon release binaries; MIT license.
- Run cargo xtask check for the full local gate; the release workflow is manual-only.

## Docs

- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Codex-Discord-Rich-Presence/main/docs/index.md): Task-based guide to installation, runtime contracts and maintenance.
- [Runtime contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Codex-Discord-Rich-Presence/main/docs/api/codex-presence.md): Identity, model catalog, pricing, context, provider lanes, privacy and Discord output.
- [Local schemas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Codex-Discord-Rich-Presence/main/docs/database/schema.md): Configuration schema 13, session snapshots, metrics and source provenance.
- [Terminal UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Codex-Discord-Rich-Presence/main/docs/ui/UI_SITEMAP.md): Responsive layouts, widgets, privacy controls and pause/resume behavior.
- [Windows Efficiency mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Codex-Discord-Rich-Presence/main/docs/windows-efficiency.md): Process-local power policy and read-only verification.
- [Privacy policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Codex-Discord-Rich-Presence/main/PRIVACY.md): Local storage and the fields that leave the machine.
